resources.string: He sits on top of WhatsApp, Instagram, and the rest of your apps. Drag him anywhere. Tap him to talk. He can tell you the battery, how many alerts are waiting, and a reminder you set.
Notification access only gives him the number of alerts. He does not read the messages. Turn each permission on yourself, and turn him off whenever you want.
Tap the notification to open him. Stop removes him.
Yo Brian. How can I help you today?
